data.title: Speed challenge: count the words
story: Write a function word_count(sentence) that returns a dictionary of every word and how many times it appears.
Capital letters count the same as lowercase. There are hidden tests for extra spaces and an empty sentence!

explanation: sentence.lower().split() breaks the sentence into a list of lowercase words and drops extra spaces automatically. Then count each word with result.get(word, 0) + 1 so you never hit a KeyError.
hints: Try in the console: "i like code".split(). You get a list of words.
To count, use a dictionary and result.get(word, 0) + 1 so a new word doesn't cause a KeyError.
Use .lower() before .split() so capital letters match, and split() with no argument also drops extra spaces.
